sermon.title: Changed into another man - October 9, 2022
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: The Spirit of the Lord turns us into another person. Saul received a new heart but rejected it to please people; David prepared as a shepherd, was anointed, and became a wise man of war whose praise drove out distressing spirits. Seek the Spirit to transform you.
